kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
نتباطأ (form VI)
# نَتَبَاطَأُ (natabāṭaʔu) /na.ta.baː.tˤa.ʔu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of تَبَاطَأَ (tabāṭaʔa)
# نَتَبَاطَأَ (natabāṭaʔa) /na.ta.baː.tˤa.ʔa/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of تَبَاطَأَ (tabāṭaʔa)
# نَتَبَاطَأْ (natabāṭaʔ) /na.ta.baː.tˤaʔ/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of تَبَاطَأَ (tabāṭaʔa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
